scripts.check:version-policy: npm run check:version && npm run check:changeset
scripts.check:agent-env: node scripts/bootstrap-agent-env.mjs --check --exempt test:compile,test:e2e:coverage && npm run check:agent-primitives
scripts.lint: npm run lint:package && npm run lint:size && npm run lint:workflows && eslint . && npm run lint:cycles && npm run lint:dead && npm run lint:types
scripts.ci:tokenless: npm run check:licenses && npm run check:agent-env && npm run check:interop-contract && npm run check:interop-acceptance && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:cov && npm run build
scripts.ci: npm run check:version-policy && npm run ci:tokenless && npm run check:acceptance-coverage
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-content-script.mjs && node scripts/build-service-worker.mjs && node scripts/build-gallery-page.mjs && node scripts/build-destination-pages.mjs && node scripts/build-preview-page.mjs && node scripts/copy-extension-assets.mjs && npm run check:artifacts && node scripts/check-version-policy.mjs --artifacts-only --build-info
scripts.build:release: IMAGE_TRAIL_ENABLE_INTEROP=0 IMAGE_TRAIL_ENABLE_PAGE_CONTEXT_SWITCHER=0 IMAGE_TRAIL_RELEASE_BUILD=1 IMAGE_TRAIL_E2E_TEST_BUILD=0 npm run build && node scripts/audit-extension-artifacts.mjs --require-release && node scripts/check-version-policy.mjs --artifacts-only --build-info --require-build-mode=release
scripts.test:unit: node scripts/run-guarded.mjs --label test:unit -- npm run test:unit:inner
scripts.test:unit:inner: npm run test:compile && npm run test:unit:run
scripts.test:dom: node scripts/run-guarded.mjs --label test:dom -- npm run test:dom:inner
scripts.test:dom:inner: npm run test:compile && npm run test:dom:run
scripts.test:run: npm run test:unit:run && npm run test:dom:run
scripts.test:cov: node scripts/run-guarded.mjs --label test:cov -- npm run test:cov:inner
scripts.test:cov:inner: npm run typecheck && npm run test:compile && c8 --clean=true --check-coverage=false --reporter=none npm run test:unit:run && c8 --clean=false npm run test:dom:run
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/run-guarded.mjs --label test:e2e --rss-mb 12288 --timeout-s 1800 -- npm run test:e2e:inner
scripts.test:e2e:ui: node scripts/run-guarded.mjs --label test:e2e:ui --rss-mb 12288 --timeout-s 0 -- npm run test:e2e:ui:inner
scripts.test:e2e:headed: node scripts/run-guarded.mjs --label test:e2e:headed --rss-mb 12288 --timeout-s 0 -- npm run test:e2e:headed:inner
scripts.test: node scripts/run-guarded.mjs --label test -- npm run test:inner
scripts.test:inner: npm run typecheck && npm run test:compile && npm run test:run
